`flutter_ui/lib/shell/app_shell.dart` — `_StatusPill` was a `StatelessWidget` with no inputs
that always rendered "Connecting…", a grey dot and `onPressed: null`. It is now a stateful widget
driven by an injected `Future<String?> Function()?`, mirroring
`MainActivity.updateUrlDisplay()`:

- **No URL means no pill** — `return const SizedBox.shrink()`. That is the substance of the fix.
  Native sets `urlBar` to `View.GONE` precisely because the Dashboard connect card already
  reports "No tunnel running", and duplicating it with a placeholder that says something untrue
  was worse than silent.
- With a URL: the real address, the primary/online dot colour, and a copy button that actually
  puts it on the clipboard.
- Polls at 10s, the cadence the Dashboard already uses for tunnel state. A tunnel comes and goes
  on a human timescale; polling faster only costs IPC round-trips.
- A throwing source is treated as "no tunnel", which is what native does too — it hides the bar
  whether the URL is empty or unavailable.

`main.dart` passes `_daemonChannel.tunnelUrl` — the source BladeWatch-m1po already built and had
wired only into the Dashboard. No second lookup path was added.

## Tests

New `test/shell/status_pill_test.dart`, 6 tests: no-tunnel hides it, an absent source behaves the
same, a live tunnel shows the real URL, the copy button copies, the pill DISAPPEARS again when a
tunnel drops mid-session, and a throwing source hides rather than crashes.

**Mutation-verified**: restoring the old always-render-placeholder behaviour makes the suite fail;
reverting the mutation makes it pass.

One existing test had to change: `app_shell_test.dart`'s "shows the default (not-yet-connected)
status pill text" asserted `find.text('Connecting…')` was present — it was pinning the bug. It is
INVERTED rather than deleted, so the regression is now explicitly guarded, with a comment saying
why.

## Verified on device

Toolbar shows no pill on any screen, with all three daemons healthy and no zrok token configured.
The Dashboard connect card still says "No tunnel running" — the one correct place for it.

Not verified: the live-tunnel rendering path on device, because no tunnel is configured here.
BladeWatch-m1po exercised that path with a stand-in process and BladeWatch-n9l5 tracks a real
tunnel run; the widget tests cover the states in the meantime.

## Gates

flutter analyze clean; 1391 Dart tests pass; Dart coverage 99.97% (6991/6993);
`./gradlew test koverVerify assembleDebug validateArbCatalogs validateAndroidStrings` all green.

Nothing committed.

title: Diagnostics Camera tile stuck on 'Probing...' and tunnel line hardcoded offline (unwired injected sources)
description:
## Problem

Found during BladeWatch-imh6.2's per-screen parity sweep, comparing native and Flutter
Diagnostics side by side on the head unit.

Two health tiles on the Flutter Diagnostics screen are wired to placeholder sources that were
never swapped for the real ones, so they can never show a true value.

### 1. The Camera tile is permanently stuck on "Probing..."

    native:   CAMERA  "Camera 0"     green dot
    Flutter:  CAMERA  "Probing..."   amber dot

Confirmed on device: still "Probing..." after 40+ seconds on the screen, and again after
navigating away and back. It is not slow, it never resolves.

Root cause, `flutter_ui/lib/main.dart` around line 231:

```dart
late final DiagnosticsController _diagnosticsController = DiagnosticsController(
  ...
  // tunnelUrlSource/cameraConfigSource stay at their defaults until
  // BladeWatch-m1po/BladeWatch-hygs add the IPC paths they need.
);
```

`cameraConfigSource` therefore stays at `_defaultCameraConfig()`, which returns
`const CameraProbeConfig()` — i.e. `probedCameraId = -1`. And
`DiagnosticsController._refreshCamera` maps that straight to the probing state:

```dart
_cameraStatus = config.probedCameraId < 0 ? CameraTileStatus.probing : CameraTileStatus.active;
```

**The comment is now stale.** BladeWatch-hygs is CLOSED, but it added
`config_get_section`/`config_put` behind an explicit allow-list of `statusOverlay` and
`developerOptions` only — it never exposed whatever section carries the probed camera id. So the
IPC path this tile needs still does not exist.

### 2. The Diagnostics Tunnel line is hardcoded offline

Same constructor, same stale comment: `tunnelUrlSource` is still `_noTunnelUrl`, which always
returns null, so the Network card's "Tunnel · Offline" line is a constant.

BladeWatch-m1po IS closed and DID add the real `DaemonChannel.tunnelUrl` — but its close reason
says it swapped **DashboardController**'s `tunnelUrlSource`. DiagnosticsController's was left on
the default. This is currently invisible because no tunnel is running, so both agree; it will be
wrong the moment one is.

## What to do

1. **Tunnel (easy, the plumbing already exists).** Pass the same real source
   `DashboardController` already uses into `DiagnosticsController` in `main.dart`. Verify with a
   tunnel actually running that the Diagnostics Network card flips to online, the way
   BladeWatch-m1po verified the Dashboard.
2. **Camera.** Decide where the probed camera id comes from. Native reads it via
   `/api/...` — check `DiagnosticsFragment.kt`'s own camera-tile refresh for the exact source
   before inventing one. If it needs a config section, extend BladeWatch-hygs's allow-list
   deliberately (that allow-list is a security boundary — widen it explicitly and say why, do not
   remove it).
3. Delete the stale comment in `main.dart` once both are wired; leaving it pointing at closed
   issues is how this stayed invisible.
4. Both sources are constructor-injected function seams, so both are unit-testable without a
   device. Write the failing test first.

## Not a bug, recorded so it is not "fixed" by mistake

While comparing, the Storage tile differs too, and **Flutter is the correct one**:

    native:   "0 clips · 0 B used",      "51 GB free"
    Flutter:  "272 clips · 42.2 GB used", "80.9 GB free"

The device has an SD card at `/storage/E3B7-10F2` (118G, 42G used) holding 143 recordings and
618 surveillance clips, while internal `/storage/emulated/0/BladeWatch` is empty. Native is
reading internal storage — the volume with nothing on it. Flutter reads the SD card, where the
data actually is, and its 42.2 GB matches `du` exactly. Do NOT "fix" Flutter to match native
here.

(One loose thread worth a glance: Flutter says 272 clips where the SD card has 143 recordings +
618 surveillance files. The byte figure is right, so the count may be filtering to one category.
Worth confirming what it is counting, but it is not the subject of this issue.)

## Constraints

- Do NOT widen BladeWatch-hygs's IPC allow-list silently. It is a security boundary; any addition
  is deliberate and explained.
- Do NOT weaken `PeerCredentials` or `CoResidentAttackerTest`.
- Do NOT change the Storage tile to match native.
- Do NOT modify `web/`.
- Do NOT commit.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The Diagnostics Camera tile shows the real probed camera on device, matching native's
      "Camera 0", with the correct status dot colour.
- [ ] The Diagnostics tunnel line reflects a real running tunnel, verified with one running.
- [ ] The stale `main.dart` comment is gone.
- [ ] A failing test was written first for each seam, then the fix.
- [ ] `flutter analyze` clean; `flutter test --coverage` at or above the current gate (99.97%).
- [ ] Verified on the head unit against the native screen side by side.

Do not make mistakes. Read the referenced files fully before editing. Verify the build compiles
and all acceptance criteria pass before closing. If anything is ambiguous, stop and ask rather
than guessing.
close_reason:
Both halves fixed and verified on the head unit. The Camera tile now reads **Camera 0** with the
online dot, matching native exactly.

## The security decision, which is the substance of this

The camera tile needed `camera.probedCameraId`. The obvious fix was to add `camera` to
BladeWatch-hygs's IPC allowlist — and that would have been wrong twice over:

**1. That allowlist gates WRITES as well as reads.** Adding `camera` to it would have handed every
IPC caller unvalidated write access to the camera configuration in order to satisfy a READ-ONLY
status tile. So `TcpCommandServer` now has two gates: `PUBLIC_CONFIG_SECTIONS` (write, unchanged:
statusOverlay + developerOptions) and `PUBLIC_CONFIG_READABLE_SECTIONS` (read, a strict superset
that adds `camera`). `config_get_section` uses the read gate; `config_put` still uses the write
gate, so **camera remains unwritable over IPC**.

**Mutation-verified**: putting `camera` into the WRITE set — the tempting wrong fix — makes the
tests fail. `configPutStillRefusesTheCameraSection` and `cameraSectionIsReadableButNotWritable`
pin the split from both directions.

**2. The section must not be returned wholesale.** `publicConfigSection` projects an explicit list
of keys per section, and the real `camera` section carries `firmwareFingerprint`, `buildDisplay`,
`buildIncremental`, `roBuildIncremental`, `productDevice` and `nativeProbeReport` — device-
identifying strings with no business crossing this boundary for a status tile. The new case
returns exactly two fields. `cameraSectionExposesOnlyTheTwoTileFields` asserts the length is 2 and
names each of those six as forbidden, so a future change that returns the section wholesale fails.

## The rest

- **Diagnostics tunnel line**: `tunnelUrlSource` was still the always-null default even though
  BladeWatch-m1po had built `DaemonChannel.tunnelUrl` and wired it into the Dashboard only. Now
  passed here too — same source, no second path.
- **Kotlin**: `PublicConfigChannel.getCameraProbe()`, a TYPED read, because `getSection` coerces
  every value to Boolean and `probedCameraId` is an Int. This is the "add a typed method" that
  class's own comment asks for, not a generic Any-valued read. Read only — there is deliberately
  no matching setter.
- **Dart**: the mirrored `getCameraProbe()` plus `CameraProbeSource`, which adapts a channel read
  to `CameraProbeConfig`. It is a class rather than a closure in `main.dart` for a concrete
  reason: the composition root is not covered by tests, and an adapter with a real branch in it
  should not hide there. Putting it in `main.dart` first DROPPED Dart coverage 99.97% -> 99.90%;
  moving it restored 99.97%.
- Null from the read means the READ FAILED, which is deliberately distinct from a probedCameraId
  of -1 ("daemon up, nothing probed yet"). Both fall back to "Probing…", matching native's own
  defensive fallthrough, but the distinction is asserted so it cannot be collapsed by accident.
- The stale `main.dart` comment pointing at two CLOSED issues is gone. That comment is why this
  stayed invisible: both referenced tasks had shipped, neither had covered this.

## Verified on device

Clean reinstall of both APKs. Camera tile reads "Camera 0" with the primary/online dot, identical
to native's "Camera 0". Confirmed on a build with all debug instrumentation removed.

The tunnel line still reads "Tunnel · Offline" — correct, since no tunnel is configured. The live
path could not be exercised here; BladeWatch-n9l5 tracks a real tunnel run.

## Tests

Java: 5 new in `PublicConfigCommandTest` (read/write split both directions, writable-implies-
readable, the read allowlist still refusing network/surveillance/recording/etc, config_put
refusing camera, and the key projection). Needed a `cameraConfigForTest` seam because
`UnifiedConfigManager.loadConfig()` calls `android.util.Log`, which is not mocked in a JVM test —
following the file's existing `...ForTest` convention.

Dart: 6 new across `public_config_channel_test.dart` — typed int read, null on failed read,
defaulting a missing id, and three for `CameraProbeSource`.

## Gates

flutter analyze clean; 1391 Dart tests pass; Dart coverage 99.97% (6991/6993), unchanged from
before this work; `./gradlew test koverVerify assembleDebug validateArbCatalogs
validateAndroidStrings` all green. IPC token still 644, secret store still 600, three daemons
running, recording rolling.

Nothing committed.

title: Russian mistranslations, incl. 'Auto' rendered as 'Автомобиль' (car) in the language picker
description:
## Problem

BladeWatch-6y7p covers a native-speaker review of hi / th / tr / vi. Russian is NOT in that set.
It was assumed clean because it passes every structural gate -- and it does pass them; the gates
check key parity, placeholders, letterless values and (now) plural shape, none of which can see a
word that is well-formed but wrong.

Verifying BladeWatch-o424 on the head unit with the UI set to Русский turned up several
confirmed mistranslations, including two on the language picker itself -- the screen a user needs
in order to RECOVER from picking a language they cannot read.

## Confirmed defects, observed rendering on the device

**1. `language_auto_title` -- the worst one**

    en: "Auto"
    ru: "Автомобиль"        <- "automobile / car"

The language picker's "Auto (follow system)" option is labelled "Car". Note that the rail's
Vehicle entry is ALSO "Автомобиль", so two unrelated concepts now share one wrong label. Every
other "Auto" key in the catalog correctly uses "Авто" (`settings_theme_auto`,
`settings_drive_side_auto`, `location_mode_auto`, `camera_current_auto`, ...), so this is an
isolated slip, not a house style.

**2. `language_auto_subtitle`**

    en: "Follow system · {arg1}"
    ru: "Следующая система · {arg1}"    <- "the NEXT system"

"Следующая" is "next in sequence", not "follows". Should be along the lines of "Как в системе"
or "Следовать системе". Compare `settings_theme_auto`, which gets the same idea right:
"Авто (как в системе)".

**3. `camera_option_auto`**

    en: "Auto (detect on startup)"
    ru: "Автомобильный (отчет при запуске)"

Two errors in one string: "Автомобильный" is the adjective "automotive/car-related", and "отчет"
is "report", not "detect".

**4. `settings_section_overlay`**

    en: "Status overlay"
    ru: "Переложение состояния"

"Переложение" is transposition / rearrangement. The standard term for a graphical overlay is
"Наложение" (or the loanword "Оверлей"). This one is a navigation label in the Settings sub-rail.

**5. `language_picker_subtitle_fmt` -- word order**

    en: "{arg1} languages available"
    ru: "Языки {arg1} доступны"

Renders as "Языки 17 доступны". Natural Russian is "Доступно 17 языков" -- which is EXACTLY what
the sibling key `settings_language_count_format` already says ("Доступно {arg1} из {arg2}
языков"). The correct phrasing is already in the catalog; this key just does not use it.

**6. `setup_autostart_body`**

    ru: "... Найдите BladeWatch в списке и отберите поле. BYD стирает это при каждой установке —
         Вы будете переделать его после обновлений."

"отберите поле" is "take away the field" (should be "снимите флажок" -- uncheck the box), and
"Вы будете переделать его" is ungrammatical (should be roughly "вам придётся сделать это
заново").

## Why no gate can catch these

There is no structural rule separating "Автомобиль" from "Авто", or "Переложение" from
"Наложение". Each is a well-formed Russian word in the right grammatical slot. This needs a
reader, which is the argument for extending 6y7p rather than writing another check.

## What to do

1. Add **ru** to the native-speaker review set (in BladeWatch-6y7p, or as a sibling pass).
2. Fix at minimum the six keys above, in `flutter_ui/lib/l10n/app_ru.arb` AND the matching
   `app/src/main/res/values-ru/strings.xml`, keeping the two in sync.
3. Prioritise by what a user navigates BY: the language picker first (it is the recovery path
   out of a wrong language), then rail labels, then `settings_section_*` titles and subtitles,
   then body text.
4. While reviewing, look specifically for the failure mode these share: an English word with two
   senses ("Auto" = automatic vs automobile, "Follow" = conform vs next) resolved to the wrong
   sense. Grep ru for "Автомобиль" and "Следующ" as a starting point.
5. Re-verify on the head unit in Русский, not on a desktop.

## Constraints

- Do NOT hand-edit ARB catalogs -- use a json load/dump round-trip. See the
  `bladewatch-i18n-catalog-caching-and-validation` memory.
- Do NOT shorten a translation to fit a layout; that is BladeWatch-o424's concern and imh6.3
  forbids it.
- Do NOT modify `web/`.
- Do NOT commit.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All six keys above read correctly in Russian.
- [ ] `language_auto_title` is "Авто", matching every other Auto key in the catalog.
- [ ] `language_picker_subtitle_fmt` uses the same phrasing shape the catalog already uses in
      `settings_language_count_format`.
- [ ] ARB and `values-ru/strings.xml` agree for every key touched.
- [ ] A reviewer who reads Russian has passed over the language picker, the rail labels and every
      `settings_section_*` title/subtitle, with findings recorded here.
- [ ] `./gradlew validateArbCatalogs validateAndroidStrings` pass.
- [ ] Verified on the head unit with the UI language set to Русский, including that the language
      picker can still be found and used BY a Russian reader.

Do not make mistakes. Read the referenced files fully before editing. Verify the build compiles
and all acceptance criteria pass before closing. If anything is ambiguous, stop and ask rather
than guessing.
close_reason:
Reviewed by Codex acting as an outside native-speaker reviewer (the owner's call), findings
triaged, and the accepted fixes applied to BOTH catalogs and verified on the head unit.

## The outside review

`codex exec` (gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh) was given the English source and current Russian for 21 of the
highest-traffic keys — language picker, rail labels, settings section titles and subtitles — with
the in-car context and an explicit instruction to say so rather than guess if unsure.

Verdict: **ru: 5 high, 9 medium, 0 low.**

It independently reproduced all four high-severity defects I had found by inspection, and added a
fifth (`setup_autostart_body`). Independent agreement on those four is worth more than my own
finding of them.

## Applied — 5 high

    language_auto_title           Автомобиль                  -> Авто
    language_auto_subtitle        Следующая система · {arg1}  -> Использовать язык системы · {arg1}
    camera_option_auto            Автомобильный (отчет...)    -> Авто (определяется при запуске)
    settings_section_overlay      Переложение состояния       -> Наложение статуса
    setup_autostart_body          ...отберите поле...         -> ...снимите флажок... (+ the
                                                                 ungrammatical final clause fixed)

## Applied — 3 of the 9 medium

    language_picker_subtitle_fmt        Языки {arg1} доступны -> Доступно языков: {arg1}
    settings_section_surveillance       Наблюдение            -> Видеонаблюдение
    settings_section_recording_subtitle Пре/пост буферы...    -> Буферы до/после записи, кодек,
                                                                 лимиты хранилища.

## REJECTED — 5 medium, and why

The review was treated as evidence, not as instructions. Five suggestions were declined:

- **rail_location** "Местоположение" -> "Место", **rail_vehicle** "Автомобиль" -> "Авто",
  **rail_diagnostics** "Диагностика" -> "Диагн."
  All three were justified as "too long for the 80dp rail". Two of those three claims are
  **empirically false**: I measured the rail on the device during BladeWatch-o424 and only
  `rail_location` and `settings_section_about` clip — "Автомобиль" and "Диагностика" both fit.
  The reviewer cannot see the device.
  And for `rail_location`, which does clip, BladeWatch-o424 recorded an explicit decision to
  accept the truncation rather than shorten a correct word, citing imh6.3's rule against exactly
  that. An outside opinion does not silently overturn a recorded decision. "Место" is also vaguer
  ("place") than "Местоположение" ("location").
- **rail_dashboard** "Панель" -> "Обзор": a style preference between two defensible words.
  "Панель" is not wrong. Changing a working rail label is risk without benefit.
- **rail_live** "Эфир" -> "Онлайн": "Эфир" was itself a deliberate prior fix — BladeWatch-vcur
  corrected it from "Жизнь" (literally "life", a real mistranslation) to "Прямой эфир" and then
  to "Эфир" to fit the rail. The objection is that it sounds like broadcast, which is what a live
  camera feed is. Not overturning two prior decisions on a stylistic note.

## One suggestion deliberately deferred, not rejected

`settings_section_surveillance_subtitle` — Codex flagged a genuine case error ("Зон обнаружения"
should be "Зоны обнаружения"). Not fixed here, because **BladeWatch-o93h is removing the
"detection zones" clause from this string entirely** in all 17 locales: BladeWatch-s3sf deleted
that feature. Fixing the grammar of a clause that is about to be deleted is wasted work, and
would create a merge conflict with o93h. Noted on o93h instead.

## Verified on the head unit

UI set to Русский, language picker reopened:
- "Авто" where it said "Автомобиль"
- "Использовать язык системы · English" where it said "Следующая система"
- "Доступно языков: 17" where it said "Языки 17 доступны"

Locale restored to auto afterwards.

## Both catalogs

`flutter_ui/lib/l10n/app_ru.arb` AND `app/src/main/res/values-ru/strings.xml` updated together —
they had drifted on exactly this kind of change before. Android format specifiers were carried
across from the existing values (`%1$s`, `%1$d`) rather than leaving ARB-style `{arg1}` in the XML.

## Gates

`./gradlew validateArbCatalogs validateAndroidStrings` pass; flutter analyze clean; 1403 Dart
tests pass; Dart coverage 99.97% (7005/7007), unchanged.

## Still open

hi / th / tr / vi remain unreviewed — the first Codex run covering all five locales exceeded its
time budget before emitting a report, and only the Russian-only rerun completed. Those four stay
with BladeWatch-6y7p, which is what that issue is for.

Nothing committed.

title: Remove the per-quadrant detection-zone (ROI) feature end to end
description:
## Decision

Remove the per-quadrant detection-zone (ROI) feature end to end, at the user's direction, after
BladeWatch-9b0f built the first client for it.

The user's reasoning, and the evidence supporting it:

- **It has never shipped to anyone.** Native's `ui/view/RoiDrawingView.kt` was written and is
  referenced by NOTHING -- no screen, no layout, no fragment. The Angular SPA does not use the
  ROI fields either (`grep roiPolygon web/src` is empty). The Flutter editor built in 9b0f is
  the only client that has ever existed on any platform.
- **The editor draws on a blank grey box.** There is no camera backdrop, so a user places a
  motion zone without seeing what the camera sees. `RoiDrawingView` had no backdrop either.
  A `GetSnapshot(quadrant) -> bytes image_jpeg` RPC exists and would have supplied one, but was
  never wired in.
- **The one client that existed was broken.** Verified on the head unit: drawing a four-point
  zone and tapping Apply WIPED it, because the proto's `map<string, RoiPolygon>` serialises as
  `{"Q0":{"points":[...]}}` while `SurveillanceApiHandler` reads each quadrant with
  `optJSONArray` and treats a null as "clear this quadrant".

So this removes a feature that has never been usable, not one anyone depends on.

The user explicitly chose the deepest scope (UI + proto + daemon + C++) over the recommended
UI-only removal, and chose to revert the wire-shape fix rather than keep it.

## What to remove

**Flutter UI**
- Delete `flutter_ui/lib/screens/surveillance/roi_editor.dart` and
  `flutter_ui/test/screens/surveillance/roi_editor_test.dart`.
- `surveillance_controller.dart`: `_editRoiPolygons`, `_editRoiEnabled`, `roiPolygonFor`,
  `roiEnabledFor`, `setRoiPolygon`, `setRoiEnabled`, `undoRoiPoint`, `clearRoi`, the
